production.note: US model year 2022 only. Quotes: "In celebration of the final year of second generation NSX production, every 2022 Acura NSX produced at the Performance Manufacturing Center in Marysville, Ohio will be a Type S model." and "Just 350 of the limited run supercar will be built for global distribution, with 300 units destined for U.S. customers". The standard NC1 NSX (2017-2021) is a separate record.

body.note: Inferred: Acura calls it an 'electrified supercar' and its spec sheet gives 'Body Type Multi-Material Spaceframe'; neither opened page uses the word coupe. Same two-door fixed-roof body as the standard NC1 NSX.

configuration.note: 'Twin-Turbo Aluminum-Alloy 75-Degree V-6' plus three electric motors; configuration is the combustion engine.

fuel.note: 'Hybrid Battery Type Lithium-Ion (Li-Ion)'; Acura describes a hybrid powertrain with no external charging.

powerHp.note: Combined system output. Quote: "System Combined Power (hp) 600". The engine alone is rated 'Power (hp @ rpm) 520 @ 6500-6850'. The reveal release gives 'Combined System Horsepower (SAE Net)' of '600 (+27)' against the 2021 NSX's 573 (acura-nsx-type-s-reveal-2021).

weightLb.note: Standard equipment. Quote: "Curb Weight (lbs.) with standard equipment 3,960". With the optional Lightweight Package: "Curb Weight (lbs.) with Lightweight Package 3,903". No estimate label on the sheet.

sources.title: Acura Debuts Limited Production 600hp NSX Type S at Monterey Car Week
